framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4) and 31(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure by persons acquiring or ceasing to hold shares/voting rights above specified thresholds; governs timing and content of disclosure to stock exchange.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Code 2011 - Regulation 31 (Public Announcement and Detailed Public Statement)

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 - Section 56(2)(vii) (Gift of shares)

headline: Dr. Y.K. Hamied submits SEBI Takeover Code disclosure under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5)
sum: Dr. Y.K. Hamied, Cipla's promoter, filed a mandatory disclosure with the NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, likely triggered by a change in shareholding or control structure requiring announcement to the market.
detail: Under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) mandate disclosure when a person acquires or ceases to hold shares or voting rights that cross key thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, etc.) or when control changes hands. The filing with NSE indicates a material event affecting Cipla's shareholding structure. No acquisition value or shareholding percentage is disclosed in the regulatory filing itself; the substance of the disclosure would be in the appended form.
